scope: Per spacecraft; housekeeping telemetry destined for Earth, excludes lunar PNT broadcast
notes: All 7 rates are now calculated from channel counts, bits and cadence. Payload 100bps and Structures 32bps are reverse-engineered illustrative calibrations, NOT independently validated measurements. PDF values remain benchmarks. Replace all placeholders with hardware owners' inventories.

subsystems.name: payload_housekeeping
subsystems.source: PDF §2.7.3 (p.14): 100 bps continuous housekeeping. Names clock lock status, clock cell temperatures and SSPA RF power; the PDF gives no channel count, bit depth or cadence.

components.name: clock_lock_status
components.source: PDF §2.7.3 names it; no numbers given

components.name: clock_cell_temperatures
components.source: PDF §2.7.3 names it; no numbers given

components.name: sspa_rf_power
components.source: PDF §2.7.3 names it; no numbers given

subsystems.notes: Itemised rate is 0 because no documented channel has count, bits and cadence together. The 100 bps aggregate is kept as a provisional TT&C sizing value; the unitemised remainder is shown separately. Nothing was invented to reach 100 bps.
subsystems.owner_todo: PAYLOAD OWNER: provide for clock lock status, clock cell temperatures and SSPA RF power the number of channels, bits per sample and sampling interval, and say whether 100 bps includes packet headers or other channels.
subsystems.telemetry_formula: R_subsystem_bps = sum(count_i * bits_per_sample_i / interval_seconds_i) for all channels i; only evaluate when all required channel inputs and complete inventory are available
subsystems.fallback_policy: Use pdf_rate_bps for TT&C sizing while inventory is incomplete; do not substitute missing channel values or force the sum to match PDF.
subsystems.formula_note: This is a documentation field. Null means unknown. itemisation_complete must be set true only when owner confirms the inventory covers all nominal housekeeping channels. Existing calculator handles fallback and provenance.

subsystems.name: structures_mechanisms
subsystems.source: PDF §7.5.3 (p.52): 32 bps. Documents 8 deployment switch bits, 2x16-bit SADM encoders, 2x16-bit HGA resolvers and 6 RTDs at 0.2 Hz. Cadences of switches/encoders/resolvers and RTD bit depth are not given.

components.name: structural_rtd
components.source: PDF §7.5.3: 6 RTDs at 0.2 Hz (=5 s); bit depth missing

subsystems.notes: Documented numbers are kept; every missing number stays null. Itemised rate is 0 because no channel is complete. 32 bps stays a provisional sizing value with the full unitemised remainder.
